context: Two young men, both married, share a brief check-in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Riku, how are you? Have you been busy lately?
lines.style: Warm, genuine opening. Leans in with real affection—no performance. Soft pace, steady breath. The question of someone who actually wants to know.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、相変わらず。仕事、家族、両方で。
lines.en: Yeah, same as always. Work and family both, you know.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact but not tired. Slight shrug in the voice. Honest without complaint. Brief pause after the first word—gathering his thoughts without rushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 俺も。家族って、ね、本当に、毎日、新鮮。
lines.en: Me too. Family is just… it's different every day, honestly.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost discovering the truth as he speaks it. Soft on the opening. Slight smile in the voice. Not lecturing—just noticing something true.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お互い、頑張ろう。家族、大事にして。
lines.en: Let's keep at it. We've got to take care of them.
lines.style: Firmer than before—resolve underneath. Not demanding, offering solidarity. Eye-contact steady. Closes on the word 'them' with quiet commitment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Brief, sure. No hesitation. Warm agreement—the kind you give when you mean it completely. Closes the moment.
